tei:div.tei:p: rin chen ril bu 'thag thabs kyi zhal gdams bzhugs so// ༈ rin chen ril bu 'thag thabs ni thog mar sman rnams gang sra nas brdungs te zhib mor song tshe dar seng zhib mo la btsags te thams cad dul ba dang phyogs gcig tu skam btags nyin gcig bya// de nas 'dam 'thag bya tshul ni dngul chu dul ma mu zi ser po dang mnyam du rdo gzhong drod ma yal bar snga dro gcig skam btags bya/ de nas star bu'i chus bran te snga dro gcig 'dam btags bya/ de nas de'i steng du rin po che rnams dang gser sogs lnga po blugs la rgyang tsam 'thag /de'i steng du bzang drug dang*/ rdo rnams dang*/ rwa sgro spu rnams blugs la rgyang tsam 'dam btags bya/ de nas sngo shing khaṇ+ḍa 'bru sman sogs sman thams cad blugs la rgyang tsam 'thag /de nas lcags rtsi'i a ru ra blugs la se 'bru'i khu bas bran te/ nyin zhag bdun gyi ring la rdo gzhong drod ma yal bar 'dam btags bya zhing 'dzab bzla// 'di'i ring la sman bla longs sku'i sgrub pa bya zhing dgong re bzhin tshogs 'khor bya/ bshags pa la 'bad cing dam tshig gtsang ba gal che/ ril bu grib skam thon nas sman bla'i snying po ci mang gis rab gnas bya zhing rab gnas gzhan yang tshul bzhin du bya ba gnad kyi man ngag ste gal che ba yin no// //maṅga laṃ//
